sentence: The firm-characteristics group adds the sorting the RBV expects: growth concentrates among the larger firms [CITE], and the same traits soften the downside, since weak IT bases and poor ratings deepen the announcement penalty
passage: [Lui et al. (2022), p. 373] "Nonmanufacturing firms and firms with weak information technology capabilities or low credit ratings suffer a more negative impact compared with other firms."

gemini.overclaim: The firm-characteristics group adds the sorting the RBV expects: growth concentrates among the larger firms [CITE], and the same traits soften the downside
gemini.note: The passage supports the claim that weak IT capabilities and poor credit ratings deepen negative impacts, but it contains no mention of the resource-based view (RBV), firm size, or growth concentration.
